supersedes_draft: PROTOCOL_DRAFT.json (scope reduced below; missing-data and categorical-omega cells deferred, not certified)
distinction: Formula correctness = validation/evidence/ctt_reference/COMPARISON.json (numerical agreement). This study = recovery of each method's own population estimand under explicit measurement models.

estimands.alpha: alpha(Sigma) = k/(k-1) (1 - tr Sigma / 1'Sigma1) of the generating covariance
estimands.kr20: alpha(Sigma_binary) of the exact population covariance of the binary items (sample-variance KR-20 == sample alpha)
estimands.omega_std: (sum lambda*)^2 / ((sum lambda*)^2 + sum(1 - lambda*^2)), lambda* = standardized generating loadings
estimands.omega_raw: (sum lambda)^2 / ((sum lambda)^2 + sum psi) of the generating raw loadings/uniquenesses
estimands.reported_not_gated: true reliability var(T)/var(X) of the raw total (continuous) for context

designs.continuous: multivariate normal one-factor; models tau-equivalent (lambda=.6, psi=.64) and congeneric (lambda linspace .4-.8, psi=1-lambda^2, item SDs linspace .5-2 applied to raw scale); N {200,1000}; k {6,20}; 8 cells
designs.binary: probit threshold model X=1[lambda F + e > tau], lambda linspace .5-.8, tau linspace -1..1; exact population covariance by bivariate-normal orthant probabilities; N {200,1000}; k {6,20}; 4 cells; methods alpha/kr20, feldt_brennan, feldt_gilmer only (Pearson omega on binary has no registered estimand here)
designs.missingness: none (complete data). Missing-data and categorical-omega scopes NOT in this study.

replications.seeds: numpy.random.default_rng([20261126015, cell, r]); development smoke only with root 20261126014

gates_per_method_and_cell.refusal: None/NaN results are refusals; counted, never dropped silently; refusal rate <= .01 (closed-form methods) and <= .05 (omega); bias over non-refused
gates_per_method_and_cell.simultaneity: a method is CERTIFIED only if it passes in every applicable cell; otherwise PARTIAL (some cells) or NOT CERTIFIED (none); failed cells archived

certification_scope: complete continuous normal one-factor data (and binary probit for alpha/KR-20/Feldt), N 200-1000, k 6-20; estimand = method's own population functional, NOT true reliability unless the model makes them equal (tau-equivalent alpha)
